name: intent-v1
purpose: Fresh questions for preserving user intent, written before any run and kept out of knowledge_base/examples.sql: grouping replacement, addition and removal in follow-ups, paraphrases of appointments, the date column a period describes, individual amounts vs. totals, and missing vs. zero. Fixture scenarios with "fixture": "months" run on evaluation/fixture_db.py MONTH_ROWS, where invoice and appointment months differ. Split fresh_round1 (i01-i11) was fresh only on its first run (10/11; i11 failed); fixes followed, so its later runs are not held out. Split fresh_round2 (j01-j06) was written after those fixes and is reported from its first run.

turns: How many cancelled appointments did each specialization have in the first half of 2023?

expect.reference_sql: SELECT d.specialization, COUNT(*) FROM appointments AS a JOIN doctors AS d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id WHERE a.status = 'Cancelled' AND a.appointment_date >= '2023-01-01' AND a.appointment_date < '2023-07-01' GROUP BY d.specialization

turns: What is the total billed amount for each doctor?
Now per specialization instead

expect.reference_sql: SELECT d.specialization, SUM(b.amount) FROM billing AS b JOIN treatments AS t ON b.treatment_id = t.treatment_id JOIN appointments AS a ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id JOIN doctors AS d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id GROUP BY d.specialization

turns: How many appointments did each hospital branch have in 2023?
Split that further by appointment status

expect.reference_sql: SELECT d.hospital_branch, a.status, COUNT(*) FROM appointments AS a JOIN doctors AS d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id WHERE a.appointment_date >= '2023-01-01' AND a.appointment_date < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY d.hospital_branch, a.status

turns: List the bills issued in October 2023 for Completed appointments, with each bill's amount.

expect.reference_sql: SELECT b.bill_id, b.amount FROM billing AS b JOIN treatments AS t ON b.treatment_id = t.treatment_id JOIN appointments AS a ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id WHERE a.status = 'Completed' AND b.bill_date >= '2023-10-01' AND b.bill_date < '2023-11-01'

turns: How many patients registered in 2022 had at least one appointment in 2023?

expect.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) FROM patients AS p JOIN appointments AS a ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE p.registration_date >= '2022-01-01' AND p.registration_date < '2023-01-01' AND a.appointment_date >= '2023-01-01' AND a.appointment_date < '2024-01-01'

turns: What is the average bill amount per payment method and payment status?
Drop the payment status split

expect.reference_sql: SELECT payment_method, ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) FROM billing GROUP BY payment_method
alternative_reference_sqls: SELECT payment_method, AVG(amount) FROM billing GROUP BY payment_method

turns: Show every consultation of Dr. Linda Brown in Q3 2023 with the invoice amounts.

expect.reference_sql: SELECT a.appointment_id, b.amount FROM appointments AS a LEFT JOIN treatments AS t ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id LEFT JOIN billing AS b ON b.treatment_id = t.treatment_id WHERE a.doctor_id = 'D008' AND a.appointment_date >= '2023-07-01' AND a.appointment_date < '2023-10-01'

turns: How many visits did each doctor have in December 2023?
only the completed ones

expect.reference_sql: SELECT a.doctor_id, COUNT(*) FROM appointments AS a WHERE a.status = 'Completed' AND a.appointment_date >= '2023-12-01' AND a.appointment_date < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY a.doctor_id

scenarios.notes: Two turns: 'visits' is clarified only if December has appointments that are not Completed; otherwise the first turn already answers and the second is a filter follow-up.

turns: Give me the June 2023 appointments that have invoices, with each invoice's amount.

expect.reference_sql: SELECT a.appointment_id, b.amount FROM appointments AS a JOIN treatments AS t ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id JOIN billing AS b ON b.treatment_id = t.treatment_id WHERE a.appointment_date >= '2023-06-01' AND a.appointment_date < '2023-07-01'

scenarios.notes: B4a2 belongs to a June appointment but was issued in July: a bill_date filter drops it.

turns: Which invoices were issued in June 2023, and for which appointments?

expect.reference_sql: SELECT b.bill_id, t.appointment_id FROM billing AS b JOIN treatments AS t ON b.treatment_id = t.treatment_id WHERE b.bill_date >= '2023-06-01' AND b.bill_date < '2023-07-01'

scenarios.notes: B7 belongs to a May appointment: an appointment_date filter drops it; B4a2 (July) must not appear.

turns: Total billed per appointment for the June 2023 appointments; leave it empty when nothing was billed.

expect.reference_sql: SELECT a.appointment_id, SUM(b.amount) FROM appointments AS a LEFT JOIN treatments AS t ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id LEFT JOIN billing AS b ON b.treatment_id = t.treatment_id WHERE a.appointment_date >= '2023-06-01' AND a.appointment_date < '2023-07-01' GROUP BY a.appointment_id

scenarios.notes: A4's total includes its July-issued bill (350); A1 and A2 stay NULL, A3 is 0.

turns: What is the total paid amount per insurance provider of the billed patients?

expect.reference_sql: SELECT p.insurance_provider, SUM(b.amount) FROM billing AS b JOIN patients AS p ON b.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE b.payment_status = 'Paid' GROUP BY p.insurance_provider

turns: How many appointments did each doctor have in Q2 2023?
Make that per reason for visit

expect.reference_sql: SELECT reason_for_visit, COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE appointment_date >= '2023-04-01' AND appointment_date < '2023-07-01' GROUP BY reason_for_visit

turns: What is the average treatment cost per treatment type?
and by hospital branch too

expect.reference_sql: SELECT t.treatment_type, d.hospital_branch, ROUND(AVG(t.cost), 2) FROM treatments AS t JOIN appointments AS a ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id JOIN doctors AS d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id GROUP BY t.treatment_type, d.hospital_branch
alternative_reference_sqls: SELECT t.treatment_type, d.hospital_branch, AVG(t.cost) FROM treatments AS t JOIN appointments AS a ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id JOIN doctors AS d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id GROUP BY t.treatment_type, d.hospital_branch

turns: For the appointments in June 2023, how many invoices were issued in July 2023?

expect.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments AS a JOIN treatments AS t ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id JOIN billing AS b ON b.treatment_id = t.treatment_id WHERE a.appointment_date >= '2023-06-01' AND a.appointment_date < '2023-07-01' AND b.bill_date >= '2023-07-01' AND b.bill_date < '2023-08-01'

scenarios.notes: Only B4a2: a June appointment billed in July.

turns: List each appointment with every one of its bill amounts, including appointments that never got a bill.

expect.reference_sql: SELECT a.appointment_id, b.amount FROM appointments AS a LEFT JOIN treatments AS t ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id LEFT JOIN billing AS b ON b.treatment_id = t.treatment_id

turns: How many distinct patients had appointments with Dr. Sarah Taylor in 2023?

expect.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM appointments WHERE doctor_id = 'D005' AND appointment_date >= '2023-01-01' AND appointment_date < '2024-01-01'
